turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. My son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
I didn't come in for thanks. Who decided, and when?
I admire how you fight for your kids. I'd have wanted a mom like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
We really want the same thing here, you and me. We're on the same team.
Then why are we here? A team doesn't put a zero in the gradebook first and ask questions later. Answer me, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
So as teammates, can we just move forward?
"Move forward." From a zero nobody explained to me, entered before anyone called home, which your own procedure 4.2 says you don't do. Did you speak to Owen before you entered it, yes or no?
